checks.note: Requests page documents only HTTP Basic (API key SID/secret, or Account SID/Auth Token). But Twilio docs show OAuth 2.0 client-credentials: POST oauth.twilio.com/v2/token returns a Bearer access token for REST calls (OAuth APIs GA per Apr 2026 changelog). The record omitted OAuth2. I saw this via search results, not a full page fetch.
Trial page confirms 30-day expiry, 5 verified numbers, free units (100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice min), upgrade path, and that A2P 10DLC needs a paid account.
Requests page documents a RESTful HTTP API (POST/GET/DELETE, JSON responses). Breadth 'broad' is consistent with the multi-product API surface, but the page does not enumerate it.

The MCP page confirms an official Twilio-hosted server at mcp.twilio.com/docs. It is docs and API-reference search only, read-only, public beta, no auth. OAuth API tools are planned. The twilio-labs alpha MCP is described as experimental and unsupported by Twilio Support.

ready_with_caveats still fits. The API is usable via a self-serve trial, and the caveats are the trial limits, A2P registration needing a paid account, and the docs-only official MCP. The blocker text needs a small fix to mention OAuth.

corrected.one_liner: Cloud communications platform with APIs for SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email, verification and related messaging/voice services.
corrected.auth_notes: HTTP Basic with API key SID + secret (recommended) or Account SID + Auth Token (required by some endpoints). OAuth 2.0 client-credentials is also available: an OAuth app's client ID and secret are exchanged at oauth.twilio.com/v2/token for a Bearer access token (GA per Apr 2026 changelog). Verified from search results, not a full page fetch.
corrected.access_notes: Free trial account (expires 30 days after sign-up) gives the same Account SID/Auth Token and API key management. Limits: send only to up to 5 verified numbers, sign-up country only, Twilio templates only; free units 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes. Upgrading to paid removes restrictions. Production use is pay-as-you-go; US A2P 10DLC registration requires a paid account.
corrected.blocker: Trial is time-limited and restricted. Production needs a paid account, and US SMS needs A2P 10DLC registration. The official MCP server is docs-search only (public beta, read-only, no API calls). OAuth-authenticated API tools are planned for it. The twilio-labs alpha MCP (@twilio-alpha/mcp) wraps the public API but is experimental and unsupported.
